notes.title: Dungeon Island will be FREE TO PLAY soon!
notes.content:
Starting from the 10th of April everyone will be able to play the game for free! Tell your friends and enjoy the game for free :).
The reason why I choose to make it free to play is that I want to make the game accessible to everyone.

notes.title: Version 1.0.0 is out!
notes.content:
[h1]The game has now an ending and steam achievements![/h1]
[b]Additions[/b]
1) (Game ending) Demon Lair level
2) Final boss
3) Steam Stats and achievements
4) Death counter on save file
5) Stats in the option menu
6) Health bars
7) Villagers
8) New mob: Master demon / guardian
9) New item: mysterious stone
10) New recipe: mysterious stone recipe
[b]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/b]
1) Beach tiles colors
2) Rocks sprite
3) Palm sprite
4) Fixed tools hit counts decrement
6) [b]A lot of bug fixing and playtesting about the last level, steam achievements and the save load system [/b]

notes.title: Version 0.1.2 is ready!
notes.content:
1) Map system (toggle using "M") + minimap in top right corner
2) oven errors fixed
3) fixed other menu issues
4) Added shortcut to crafting "C"
5) Pickup key changed from "C" to "R" or "V"
6) You can now click on an object to pick it up/ interact
7) Fixed some mob behaviours (but pigs still want to do moon walks like Micheal Jackson)
8) Pig hits fixed
9) Added pic preview on save file
10) Added version name on save file
11) Improved animations of main character
12) Top view is zoomed out 
13) Added pickup animation
14) LP of some items changed
15) Ores can drop more resources
16) Easter egg message edited
17) Fixed fire rate and animations of Demon "LittleEye"
18) New mob "MindTrick" + drop (Arm of control), this mob is rare
19) Edited hit messages
20) Now you can throw objects using "T", hold T + mouse scroll to change object to throw
21) Some objects are shiny (diamonds,iron,diamond sword) using shaders
22) You can now equip food
23) Tutorial and commands menu edited : added instructions about how to throw objects
24) Added spooky sounds
25) Craftings are sorted by what you can craft
26) Recipes are now marked magenta on the map
Bonus: Game desktop icon changed

notes.title: 0.1.1 Update notes
notes.content:
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
- Fixed volume level not loading in the main menu
- Fixed lag issue due to many entities spawn
- Fixed duplication bug when picking up objects and inventory was full
- Fixed issue with wooden ceiling not stacking correctly in the inventory
- Fixed sudden input lock when leaving - entering game in particular situations
- Fixed pause menu overlapping with other interfaces
- Fixed opening inventory from pause menu
- Fixed losing crafting ingredients and output craft when inventory is full 
- Fixed inventory full issues
[b]Additions & Tweaks[/b]
- Added alert message when inventory is full
- Added opacity to equip inventory
- Expanded equip inventory from 2 to 5
- Added numbers under equip inventory's slots to show duration of tools and quantity of objects
- Improved some descriptions and titles
- Added red/green color to recipes that you can/can't craft
- Added Button "craft all" to recipes
- Added text to recipes that shows how many output items do you have in inventory
- Improved UI scale and position (Health bar, Hunger bar, buttons and equip bar)
- Improved camera zoom (increased zoom out)
- Added button "collect all" that allows you to collect all objects on the ground
- Added shortcut buttons to items in the equip inventory 1,2,3,4,5
